claim_boundary: This theorem rules out globally regular relational clocks among all real one-field stealth configurations of the standard positive-sign conformal scalar with quartic Weyl-invariant potential on the unit cylinder, including inhomogeneous configurations. It does not rule out generalized scalar actions or genuinely non-conformally-flat Bach-sourced clock backgrounds.

conventions.clock_requirement: T smooth and grad(T) everywhere timelike and nonzero
conventions.field: one real conformal scalar T of Weyl weight -1 with standard positive kinetic sign
conventions.metric: g=-dt^2+dOmega_3^2 on the unit Einstein cylinder
conventions.spatial_embedding: n in S3 subset R4 and C.n is the complete l=1 harmonic family

global_obstruction.time_dependent_case: if A^2+B^2>0 choose n perpendicular to C and a zero of A cos(t)+B sin(t); then sigma=0
global_obstruction.time_independent_case: if A=B=0 and C nonzero choose n perpendicular to C; then sigma=0 and there is no time clock

not_established: a no-go theorem for generalized non-Noetherian or higher-derivative conformal scalar actions
a no-go theorem for positive-energy Bach-sourced non-conformally-flat clocks
a support-local all-row BV construction for a surviving clock
an interacting, boundary, or quantum D verdict

reciprocal_stress.polynomial_tensor_equation: sigma(Hess_mn sigma-g_mn Box sigma)+(3/2)g_mn(grad sigma)^2+(1/2)sigma^2 G_mn-(3/4)kappa g_mn=0

timelike_gradient_obstruction.regular_test_point: choose n perpendicular to C and a time extremum of u=A cos(t)+B sin(t)
